statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); branch=$(cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null && git -c core.fileMode=false config --global --add safe.directory '*' 2>/dev/null; git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'no-git'); printf '\033[36m%s\033[0m on \033[32m%s\033[0m' "$(basename "$cwd")" "$branch"
